Transindia Real Estate) | spouse = Arathi Shetty | children = Vaishnav and Shloka | awards = [[Order of Leopold II|Commander, Order of Leopold II]] (2015) | footnotes = }} '''Shashi Kiran Shetty''' (born 7 June 1957) is an Indian [[Businessperson|businessman]] and [[Entrepreneurship|entrepreneur]], the founder of [[Allcargo Logistics|Allcargo Group]], a logistics conglomerate headquartered in [[Mumbai]].{{Cite web |title=Gati Appoints Shashi Kiran Shetty as New Chairman |url=http://bwpeople.businessworld.in/article/Gati-Appoints-Shashi-Kiran-Shetty-as-New-Chairman/27-07-2020-301760 |access-date=2020-07-31 |website=BW people |language=en}} He established [[Allcargo Logistics]] in 1994 and developed it into a multinational logistics enterprise providing freight forwarding, contract logistics, and [[Supply chain management|supply-chain services]] across global markets.{{Cite web|url=http://www.mumbaimirror.com/mumbai/others/Kakas-Aashirwad-is-dream-come-true-for-Bandra-tycoon/articleshow/39014876.cms|title=Kaka's Aashirwad is 'dream come true' for Bandra tycoon - Mumbai Mirror -|access-date=2016-06-30}} Under Shetty's leadership, the group expanded through acquisitions including Belgium-based logistics firm ECU-Line (later renamed ECU Worldwide) and Indian express logistics company [[Allcargo Gati Ltd|Gati Ltd]].{{Cite news |last=Correspondent |first=Special |date=2019-12-05 |title=Allcargo Logistics to buy controlling stake in Gati |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/allcargo-logistics-to-buy-controlling-stake-in-gati/article30197033.ece |access-date=2026-04-01 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} He also serves as Chairperson of the Board of Governors of the [[Indian Institute of Management Mumbai]].{{Cite web |last=Standard |first=Business |title=Ministry of education appoints Shashi Kiran Shetty as chairman of NITIE |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ministry-of-education-appoints-shashi-kiran-shetty-as-chairman-of-nitie-120102800696_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250707233659/https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ministry-of-education-appoints-shashi-kiran-shetty-as-chairman-of-nitie-120102800696_1.html |archive-date=2025-07-07 |access-date=2026-04-01 |website=www.business-standard.com |language=en-US}} ==Career== === Early Career === Shashi Kiran Shetty was born on 7 June 1957 in Bantwal, a town in Dakshina Kannada district of Karnataka, India. He studied commerce at Shri Venkatramana Swamy college in Bantwal before moving to Mumbai in 1978 in search of employment opportunities in the shipping industry.{{Cite web |title=Of Grit, Passion and Luck: Shashi Kiran Shetty {{!}} MYB International |url=https://www.mybinternational.com/articles/1002102/of-grit-passion-and-luck-shashi-kiran-shetty |access-date=2026-03-31 |website=www.mybinternational.com}} After arriving in Mumbai, Shetty began working in the shipping sector and gained experience in port operations and freight handling, which later influenced his decision to pursue entrepreneurship in logistics. Shetty began his career in Intermodal Transport and Trading Systems Pvt. Ltd. and later worked with Forbes Gokak. At the age of 25 he established his first venture, Trans India Freight Services Pvt. Ltd., a freight forwarding and logistics services company. === Founding of Allcargo Logistics === In 1994, Shetty founded [[Allcargo Logistics]] in Mumbai as a cargo handling and logistics company operating at the Jawaharlal Nehru Port near Mumbai. The company initially provided freight forwarding and customs-house agency services.{{Cite web |last=Zaveri |first=Jimit |date=July 22, 2021 |title=Initiating Coverage Allcargo Logistics Ltd. |url=https://www.hdfcsec.com/hsl.research.pdf/Allcargo%20Logistics%20-%20Initiating%20Coverage%2022072021.pdf |access-date=April 22, 2022 |website=[[HDFC securities]]}} Over time the company diversified into integrated logistics services including container freight stations in 2003, multimodal transportation, contract logistics in 2016,{{Cite journal |last1=Joshi |first1=G. |last2=Shetty |first2=Rakesh |date=2013-12-31 |title=Leadership for Expansion, Growth and CSR Initiatives: The Case of Allcargo Logistics Limited |journal=Nitte Management Review |url=https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=2511515 |language=en |location=Rochester, NY|ssrn=2511515 }} and supply-chain management logistics parks in 2018.{{Cite web |date=2011-04-13 |title=Riding the tide: The Shettys of Allcargo |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/cover-story/story/indias-new-business-families-shashi-kiran-shetty-family-18449-2011-04-13 |access-date=2022-07-31 |website=Business Today |language=en}} === Global expansion === Under Shetty's leadership, Allcargo expanded through acquisitions and partnerships. One of the group's major acquisitions was Antwerp-based ECU-Line, a global non-vessel operating common carrier in 2005, which strengthened its global less-than-container-load logistics network.{{Cite web |date=2015-02-20 |title=Allcargo’s Shetty gains Belgian honour |url=https://www.tradewindsnews.com/weekly/allcargo-s-shetty-gains-belgian-honour/1-1-354595 |access-date=2026-03-31 |website=TradeWinds {{!}} Latest shipping and maritime news |language=en}} The company also diversified into container freight stations in 2003, contract logistics operations in 2016, and logistics parks in 2018. In 2020, Allcargo Logistics acquired a controlling stake in Gati Ltd.,{{Cite news |title=First-gen entrepreneur Shashi Kiran Shetty feels family has played a huge role in Allcargo Logistics |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/first-gen-entrepreneur-shashi-kiran-shetty-feels-family-has-played-a-huge-role-in-allcargo-logistics/articleshow/65482868.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2022-07-31}} an Indian express logistics provider, expanding the group's presence in express distribution and domestic supply chain services.{{Cite web |date=2021-07-30 |title=Allcargo acquires 65% stake in Swedish logistics firm Nordicon Group |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/allcargo-acquires-65-stake-in-swedish-logistics-firm-nordicon-group-10185121.htm |access-date=2022-07-31 |website=cnbctv18.com |language=en}} In 2025, Gati was rebranded as Allcargo Logistics following the completion of the scheme of strategic demerger.{{cite web |title=Gati rebrands as Allcargo Gati |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/gati-rebrands-as-allcargo-gati/article67715073.ece |website=BusinessLine |date=8 January 2024 |access-date=16 May 2026}} === Institutional roles === Outside his corporate activities, Shetty has served in leadership roles within academic and industry institutions.{{Cite web |title=Mr. Shashi Kiran Shetty nominated as Chairman, NITIE, Mumbai |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/home/education/news/mr-shashi-kiran-shetty-nominated-as-chairman-nitie-mumbai/articleshow/78953270.cms |access-date=2020-11-13 |website=The Times of India|date=30 October 2020 }} He is the Chairperson of the Board of Governors of the [[Indian Institute of Management Mumbai]], formerly the National Institute of Industrial Engineering.{{Cite web |title=Board Governor {{!}} NITIE |url=https://www.nitie.ac.in/board-governor |access-date=2020-11-13 |website=www.nitie.ac.in}} He has also participated in initiatives associated with international business and industry bodies such as the Confederation of Indian Industry(CII) and ASSOCHAM.{{Cite web |title=IIM Mumbai - About Chairperson |url=https://iimmumbai.ac.in/about-chairperson |access-date=2026-03-31 |website=iimmumbai.ac.in}} ==Personal life== Shetty is married to Arathi Shetty, who is associated with the Avashya Foundation, the corporate social responsibility arm of the Allcargo Group. He has one son Vaishnav Shetty, Deputy Managing Director of Allcargo Global and one daughter Shloka Shetty.{{Cite news |last=Gupte |first=Masoom |title=Celebrations on-board: Allcargo's Shashi Kiran 2024, Shetty donated 3% of his shareholding in Allcargo Logistics to the Avashya Foundation, the group's philanthropic arm.{{Cite web |last=www.ETInfra.com |title=Allcargo founder Shashi Shetty Shashi Kiran Shetty (born 7 June 1957) is an Indian businessman and entrepreneur, the founder of Allcargo Group, a logistics conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. He established Allcargo Logistics in 1994 and developed it into a multinational logistics enterprise providing freight forwarding, contract logistics, and supply-chain services across global markets.
Under Shetty's leadership, the group expanded through acquisitions including Belgium-based logistics firm ECU-Line (later renamed ECU Worldwide) and Indian express logistics company Gati Ltd. He also serves as Chairperson of the Board of Governors of the Indian Institute of Management Mumbai.
